description: Hand-authored (not recorded) wire fixture for one full HITL flow: fresh design request -> approve tech stack -> approve blueprint -> approve diagram -> Vietnamese PDF follow-up. Every request body and SSE frame shape is copied verbatim from backend/src/routers/chat.py (RUN_STARTED/TEXT_MESSAGE_*/CUSTOM/STATE_DELTA/TOOL_CALL_*/STATE_SNAPSHOT/RUN_FINISHED, lines ~195-975) and backend/src/session/{gate_decisions,normalize,followups}.py (card shapes, tech-stack/blueprint normalization, follow-up phrase matching). Not a real LLM transcript -- content is illustrative but every field name, nesting, and event ordering matches the real backend exactly, so this is the contract oracle for: Stage 2's A/B body diff, Stage 3's message-integrity checks, and Stage 4's gate registry golden-payload tests. Swap for a real recording later without changing any test that reads this file -- the schema is what's load-bearing, not the words.

steps.label: 5. Vietnamese PDF follow-up (fresh run, no tool resume)
steps.note: THE critical fixture for section B: last message role=='user' (not 'tool') so this hits the FRESH-RUN branch again, not resume. _last_user_text() must return this Vietnamese string BYTE-IDENTICAL to what the runtime sends -- 'bao cao' matches _is_pdf_followup's whole-word 'bao cao'/'tao bao cao' phrases (followups.py:36-52), attached=false, solution_exists=true (out.png/tech_stack.json/blueprint.json are on disk from steps 1-4) -> chat.py preserves the artifacts instead of calling clear_stage_markers(). This is the exact scenario runtime/src/__tests__/message-integrity.test.ts (section B.4) and the Stage-3 live check assert on.
